notes.title: Lux Delux adds Chinese and Korean language translations
notes.notes:
Lux Delux 6.56 update is now available for downloading. This update includes translations into Chinese and Korean languages.

Full Changelog:
- Added translations into Chinese (Simplified and Tranditional) and Korean.
- The /map command now works regardless of capital/lowercase cases.
- Better behaviour when winner-picks mode is on with no map list is set.
- Network hosts will auto-restart crashed games after 3 hours of inactivity.
- Better hooks for network clients to end team-games when only 1 team remains.
- Added translation kit link to language selection.
- Windows: update the included private JRE to 8_111.
- Linux: set the temp folder inside the launch script, for wider steam compatibility.
- Windows (Steam): included a TEST executable that sets the temp folder.

If you're on Windows and get an launch error, try running the "Lux Delux TEST" executable that's beside the normal one in the Steam-Lux install location.

notes.title: Luxtoberfest 13
notes.notes:
October features our [url=http://sillysoft.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=27499]13th Annual Luxtoberfest Celebration![/url]

See that link for the schedule of events, including Twitch Speed Games during opening weekend, an All-Time High-Seeds tournament on October 8th, and more! Seek your Fortune, or play the Fool...
 
[url=http://sillysoft.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=27499][img]http://sillysoft.net/images/luxtoberfest13_600.png[/img][/url]

[b]–– Lux DLX Mobile Updates ––[/b]
 
We have just released updates to both the [url=http://sillysoft.net/lux/dlx/appstore.php]iOS version[/url] and [url=http://sillysoft.net/lux/dlx/playstore.php]Android version[/url] of Lux DLX. It now features enhanced maps, tweaks to fit modern devices, and Biohazard game mode on all platforms, to nuke out random countries on the map each game! We'll be continueing to tweak the mobile versions going forward, please let us know if you encounter any issues.

 
[b]–– Italian Unification map ––[/b]

Italian Unification is a newly available map, created by our beloved cartographer Mark Bauer. You can find it inside the map download area of Lux! 

[url=http://sillysoft.net/lux/maps/Italian%20Unification][img]http://sillysoft.net/plugins/images/Italian%20Unification_thumb500.jpg[/img][/url]

"After Napoleon's defeat, the Congress of Vienna returned Italy to a patchwork of kingdoms ruled over by the prevailing European powers. Nationalism begins to rise across the countryside as cries for a Risorgimento intensify. Revolutionary movements take hold and soon the entire peninsula is at war, each faction with their own visions of a new unifed Italy."

–– 

Hope to see you online during this year's Luxtoberfest!
Dustin Quasar,
Sillysoft Games

notes.title: Lux Delux 6.5 with winner-picks mode
notes.notes:
Lux Delux version 6.5 is now available for downloading. The biggest change in this release is the addition of a "Winner Picks" hosting mode, which allows the winner of the game to select the next map that gets played. To enable it, a host can type [b]/winnerpicks true[/b] in the chat. 

If you want to restrict the allowed maps, you can do that, by creating a winnerpicks.txt file inside the Support folder inside the Lux install folder, and writing the name of one map per line in that file. The winner will be able to pick from your list of maps then.

This release also contains a few bug-fixes and tweaks. Happy days!

notes.title: Luxtoberfest tournament schedule!
notes.notes:
October marks another year of [b]Luxtoberfest[/b], ushering in a month of tournaments and celebrations of Lux Delux. Here's the tournament schedule:

[i]October 1st Thursday[/i] :: [b][url=http://sillysoft.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=25909]Tournament of Champions for All-Time High Seeds[/url][/b], pitting the best players of all-time versus each other. 

[i]October 2-4th weekend[/i] :: [b][url=http://sillysoft.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=25910]Twitch Quick-Lux Tournament[/url][/b], ramping up the pace with high speed turns! 

[i]October 8th Thursday[/i] :: [b]Winner-Picks tournament.[/b] Featuring a selection of excellent map choices.

[i]October 10th[/i] :: [b]Rookies tournament / Old-timers tournament.[/b] Welcoming the new, propping up the old.
[i]October 11th[/i] :: [b]Castles tournament.[/b] From the dark ages to the renaissance. 

[i]October 17th[/i] :: [b]Classic tournament[/b]. Do you have chops on the map that started it all?
[i]October 18th[/i] :: [b]Vox tournament[/b]. Lux's sister game Castle Vox is a team-based simultaneous-turn wargame.

[i]October 22nd Thursday[/i] :: [b]Ladies Night tournament[/b]. If their busy schedules allow for it.  :smt061 

[i]October 24-25th weekend[/i] :: [b]TeamPlay Tournament[/b]. We will be refreshing the team-play host with the intent to make it more available in the future. Fresh teams in effect, captains wanted...

[i]October 29th Thursday[/i] :: [b]All versus 1: King of the Castle[/b]. Come try and knock Dustin off his silly throne. Featuring a sneak peak at a 'capture the flag' style Lux game mode.

[i]October 31st[/i] :: [b][url=http://sillysoft.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=25912]Luxcademy Awards[/url] Ceremony[/b] :trophy 
[i]October 31st [/i]:: [b]Halloween Costume Ball  :torch: 
[/b]
[i]All month[/i] :: [b]LuxShoppe showdown[/b]
[i]All month[/i] :: [b]Forum Games :)[/b]

See you there!

[img]http://sillysoft.net/images/luxtoberfest12_600.png[/img]

notes.title: Lux Delux is here!
notes.notes:
Sillysoft Games is very excited to release our first game Lux Delux onto Steam today. Lux Delux is a fast-paced indie TBS game of world domination, available for PC, Mac OS and Linux platforms.

Lux Delux has been around the indie game circuit for many years now. An early version was nominated as an IGF finalist back in 2005. The game now comes to Steam after graduating through Valve's Greenlight system.

Clearly inspired by the boardgame RISK, Lux Delux has grown into much more over the years, now including hundreds of maps, a biohazard mode, varied AI personalities, 18 language translations and extensive community created mods. 

Lux Delux supports an competitive online multi-player league, multi-platform across Windows, Linux, and Mac. Sillysoft has announced a series of online [url=http://sillysoft.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=25702]Mayday tournaments[/url] happening through the month of May to celebrate the release onto steam.

Lux Delux is being offered on Steam as a single package that includes 2 expansion campaigns: American History Lux and Ancient Empires Lux. Each campaign offers hand-crafted maps tat travel back in back in time through the wars that have shaped humanity.

We're launching with a 25%-off sale. Hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Achievements and Leaderboards
notes.notes:
The latest Lux Delux beta build has support for more Steam achievements, calling out some of the deeper features of the game (we have even more coming from up our sleeves still). Also we're coming online with leaderboards that sync up to the Lux [url=http://sillysoft.net/lux/rankings/]online rankings[/url]. 

Anyone that has bought Lux direct from us in the past can join the final beta week by using  [url=http://sillysoft.net/contact/registration.php]the registration key retrieval tool[/url].

We are looking forward to releasing publicly onto Steam on Friday! We've scheduled a series of [url=http://sillysoft.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=25702]Mayday Tournaments[/url] to welcome steamy new Luxers.

:)
